question_vi: Error handling middleware trong Express hoạt động như thế nào?
question_en: How does error handling middleware work in Express?
answer_html_vi:
Error handling middleware có 4 tham số (err, req, res, next) và phải đăng ký CUỐI CÙNG, sau tất cả routes.

ts
class AppError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public statusCode: number,
    message: string,
    public isOperational = true,
  ) {
    super(message)
  }
}

// bọc route async để khỏi lặp try/catch
const asyncHandler = (fn) => (req, res, next) =>
  Promise.resolve(fn(req, res, next)).catch(next)

app.use((err, req, res, next) => {
  if (err.isOperational) return res.status(err.statusCode).json({ message: err.message })
  logger.error(err)
  res.status(500).json({ message: 'Internal server error' })
})
  • AppError tách operational error (404, validation fail — lường trước được) khỏi programming error (null reference — bug thật).
  • Express 5 tự forward lỗi từ async route nên không cần asyncHandler nữa.

Lưu ý: quên tham số next thứ tư thì Express không nhận ra đây là error handler. Gọi next() sau res.json() trong error handler sẽ gây lỗi double response.
answer_html_en:
Error handling middleware takes 4 parameters (err, req, res, next) and must be registered LAST, after every route.

ts
class AppError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public statusCode: number,
    message: string,
    public isOperational = true,
  ) {
    super(message)
  }
}

// wrap async routes so try/catch is not repeated everywhere
const asyncHandler = (fn) => (req, res, next) =>
  Promise.resolve(fn(req, res, next)).catch(next)

app.use((err, req, res, next) => {
  if (err.isOperational) return res.status(err.statusCode).json({ message: err.message })
  logger.error(err)
  res.status(500).json({ message: 'Internal server error' })
})
  • AppError separates operational errors (404, validation failure — expected) from programming errors (null reference — actual bugs).
  • Express 5 forwards async route errors automatically, so asyncHandler is no longer needed.

Note: omit the fourth next parameter and Express will not treat the function as an error handler. Calling next() after res.json() inside the handler triggers a double-response error.
